values.note: 2026 peak season (May 22 - Sep 6): Standard Improved $25, Improved Waterfront and Waterfront Pull Through $32 (tent-only $25/$32). America the Beautiful Senior/Access pass holders get 50% off the primary occupant's site when the physical pass is shown at check-in.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233644/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-06: 'STANDARD IMPROVED': 25, 'IMPROVED WATERFRONT': 32, 'Waterfront Pull Through': 32) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233644 (notice: 'America the Beautiful (ATB) discount pass must be presented upon check-in for 50% camping fee discount to apply'), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233644 (Overview: 'As a primitive campground, Susquehannock does not offer electric, water, or sewer hookups'; every catalog site is STANDARD/TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 50 reservable standard (RV/trailer/tent) sites plus 11 tent-only and 3 unreservable sites, all non-electric, with level camping and parking pads. Max vehicle lengths listed run 10-75 ft (twelve standard sites list none; most 35-60), though driveway lengths are mostly 20-45 ft; most sites are back-in, with a few pull-throughs (25 and 45 ft). One wheeled unit plus one tent, or two tents, per site; two camper vehicles overnight.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 233644 (site types, permitted equipment, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Length, Driveway Entry) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233644 (notices: 'a strict maximum of 2 camping units; 1 wheeled unit with 1 tent OR 2 tents', 'After 10 PM, only 2 vehicles may be parked onsite'), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233644 ('Vault toilets are available throughout the campground, and campers can access potable water near the campground entrance. Hot showers and flush restrooms are available at Seven Points Beach, approximately a 15-minute drive away'; 'Liquid waste, such as grey water, must be disposed of at the Seven Points Dump Station'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov; check in at the Susquehannock Entrance Station from 5 pm with photo ID. Stays limited to 14 days in any 30. recreation.gov lists a 2-night weekend and 3-night holiday-weekend minimum as soft rules.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233644 (rules: maxStay 14 nights 'Rolling 30 Days', minWeekendStay 2 'soft', minHolidayWeekendStay 3 'soft'; notices 'CHECK-IN ... beginning at 5 PM', 'STAY LIMITS: ... longer than 14 days of any 30 consecutive day period'), read 2026-10-20

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233644 (notice: 'America the Beautiful (ATB) discount pass must be presented upon check-in for 50% camping fee discount to apply'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed the 2026 $25 standard / $32 waterfront rates, non-electric (now also no water/sewer), reservable on recreation.gov, the ATB 50% discount. Added 50 reservable RV/standard sites to 75 ft with a few pull-throughs, vault toilets and potable water (showers, flush toilets and dump are at Seven Points), the 14-in-30-day limit. Not stated: season dates (rate table covers only peak season; the USACE Raystown site refused plain HTTP), booking window.
